
Rasterise the parks layer (minus nature reserves, and also only keep mainland singapore)
```{r}
library(tidyterra)
full_parks_vectors <- terra::project(terra::vect(nparks_shp),"epsg:32648")
not_mainland <- c("PULAU UBIN AND CHEK JAWA", "SISTERS' ISLAND MARINE PARK")
full_parks_vectors <- full_parks_vectors |>
    filter(N_RESERVE==0) |>
    filter(!NAME %in% not_mainland)
parks_filter_raster_template <- terra::rast(full_parks_vectors, res=30)
parks_filter_raster <- terra::rasterize(full_parks_vectors, parks_filter_raster_template)
terra::writeRaster(parks_filter_raster, output_file,overwrite=TRUE)
```

Filter for the parks we're interested in
```{r}
# poi <- toupper(c("ADMIRALTY PK", "Bukit Batok Nature Park", "BUKIT BATOK TOWN PARK", "CHESTNUT NATURE PARK", "Dairy Farm Nature Park", "MOUNT FABER PARK", "RIFLE RANGE NATURE PARK", "TAMPINES ECO GREEN PK", "THOMSON NATURE PARK", "WINDSOR NATURE PARK"))

poi <- c("PULAU UBIN AND CHEK JAWA", "SISTERS' ISLAND MARINE PARK", "PULAU UNUM", "BETING BRONOK", "PULAU SEKUDU")

parks_filtered <- nparks_shp %>% 
    filter(!NAME %in% poi) |>
    filter(N_RESERVE==0)

parks_vectors <- terra::vect(x = parks_filtered)

lapply(poi,function(name){
    file_name <- paste0(gsub(" ", "_", name), ".gpkg")
    terra::writeVector(parks_vectors[parks_vectors$NAME == name,], file_name, overwrite=TRUE)
})
```

load and mask the ndvi delta with each park's vector
10 parks, 12 months, 120 files (each raster file has 2 years, NDVI and NDMI)

```{r}
ndvimi_diff_path <- "data/geotiff/ndvimi/difference_watermasked"
ndvimi_diff_files <- file.path(ndvimi_diff_path,sprintf("NDVI_NDMI_diff_%d_watermasked.tif", 1:12))
diff_rasters <- lapply(ndvimi_diff_files,terra::rast)
ndvi_diff_stack <- terra::rast(lapply(diff_rasters,function(r) r[["NDVI_diff"]]))
ndmi_diff_stack <- terra::rast(lapply(diff_rasters,function(r) r[["NDMI_diff"]]))

for (i in 1:10){
    # for each park, crop and mask the whole stack and save
    park_vector <- parks_vectors[i]
    park_vector <- terra::project(park_vector, "EPSG:32648")
    ndvi_diff_stack_cropped <- terra::crop(ndvi_diff_stack, park_vector)
    ndvi_diff_stack_masked <- terra::mask(ndvi_diff_stack_cropped, park_vector)
    ndmi_diff_stack_cropped <- terra::crop(ndmi_diff_stack, park_vector)
    ndmi_diff_stack_masked <- terra::mask(ndmi_diff_stack_cropped, park_vector)
    output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","per_park_big","ndvimi",park_vector$NAME)
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    for (n in 1:12){
        output_file <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf(paste0(park_vector$NAME, "ndvimi_difference_%d.tif"), n))
        ndvimi_layers <- c(ndvi_diff_stack_masked[[n]], ndmi_diff_stack_masked[[n]])
        terra::writeRaster(ndvimi_layers, output_file,overwrite=TRUE)
    }
}
```

do the same with precip:

```{r}
precip_diff_path <- "/Users/intan/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/NUS/MSc/BL5233/droughtNDVI/data/geotiff/climate_v2/precip/individual_years/mean_difference"
# one 2-band raster per month (mean_monthly_daily_sum, cumulative_monthly); index n = calendar month n

for (i in 1:10){
    # for each park, crop and mask each month and save
    park_vector <- parks_vectors[i]
    park_vector <- terra::project(park_vector, "EPSG:32648")
    output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","per_park_big","precip",park_vector$NAME)
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    for (n in 1:12){
        precip_diff_cropped <- terra::crop(precip_diff_rasters[[n]], park_vector)
        precip_diff_masked <- terra::mask(precip_diff_cropped, park_vector)
        output_file <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf(paste0(park_vector$NAME, "precip_difference_%d.tif"), n))
        terra::writeRaster(precip_diff_masked, output_file,overwrite=TRUE)
    }
}
```

Save them as CSVs:

```{r}
park_pixels_to_tibble <- function(park_vectors, ndvimi_rasters, precip_rasters, temp_rasters, touches = FALSE){
    park_vectors <- terra::project(park_vectors, "EPSG:32648")
    purrr::map_dfr(1:12, function(n){
        yr <- if (n <= 9) 2026 else 2025
        precip <- precip_rasters[[n]]
        names(precip) <- paste0("precip_", names(precip))
        temp <- temp_rasters[[n]]
        names(temp) <- paste0("temp_", names(temp))
        layers <- c(ndvimi_rasters[[n]], precip, temp)
        pixels <- terra::extract(layers, park_vectors, xy = TRUE, touches = touches)
        pixels |>
            mutate(
                name = park_vectors$NAME[ID],
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", yr, n))
            ) |>
            select(name, month, x, y, everything(), -ID) |>
            as_tibble()
    })
}

park_pixels <- park_pixels_to_tibble(parks_vectors, diff_rasters, precip_diff_rasters, temp_diff_rasters)

dir.create(here("data","csv"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(park_pixels, here("data","csv","park_pixels_big.csv"))

```

and summarising it per park:
```{r}
parks_all <- park_pixels |>
    group_by(name, month) |>
    summarise(
        n_pixels_ndvi = sum(!is.na(NDVI_diff)),
        mean_ndvi = mean(NDVI_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_ndvi = sd(NDVI_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_ndmi = mean(NDMI_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_ndmi = sd(NDMI_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
        across(starts_with(c("precip_", "temp_")), \(v) mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(-c(name, month), names_to = "stats", values_to = "value")

```

summarise each park's NDMI, NDVI, temp and precip 
one dataframe per variable
column = parkname | month | variable | stats | value 

Initialising the dataframe:
```{r}
parks_all <- tibble(
    name = character(),
    month = yearmonth(),
    variable = character(),
    stats = character(),
    value = double()
)
```

Loop through each park 
and then loop through each month 
and add one row at a time:

```{r}
for (i in 1:nrow(parks_vectors)){
    parent_dir <- "/Users/intan/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/NUS/MSc/BL5233/droughtNDVI/data/geotiff/per_park_big"
    park_vector <- parks_vectors[i]
    for (m in 1:12){
        if(m <= 9){
            y = 2026
        } else {
            y= 2025
        }
        # open the files
        month_pattern <- paste0("_", m, ".tif")
        ndvimi <- terra::rast(list.files(path = paste0(parent_dir, "/ndvimi/", parks_vectors[i]$NAME), full.names =TRUE, pattern = month_pattern))
        precip <- terra::rast(list.files(path = paste0(parent_dir, "/precip/", parks_vectors[i]$NAME), full.names =TRUE, pattern = month_pattern))
        temp <- terra::rast(list.files(path = paste0(parent_dir, "/temp/", parks_vectors[i]$NAME), full.names =TRUE, pattern = month_pattern))
        ndvi <- ndvimi[["NDVI_diff"]]
        ndmi <- ndvimi[["NDMI_diff"]]
        ndvi_vals <- terra::values(ndvi, mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        # find the mean ndvi
        mean_ndvi <- mean(ndvi_vals)
        # find the SD ndvi
        sd_ndvi <- sd(ndvi_vals)
        # write row
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "ndvi",
                stats = "mean_ndvi",
                value = mean_ndvi
            )
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "ndvi",
                stats = "sd_ndvi",
                value = sd_ndvi
            )   
        # find the mean ndmi
        ndmi_vals <- terra::values(ndmi, mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        mean_ndmi <- mean(ndmi_vals)
                parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "ndmi",
                stats = "mean_ndmi",
                value = mean_ndmi
            )
        # find the SD ndmi
        # write row
        sd_ndmi <- sd(ndmi_vals)
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "ndmi",
                stats = "sd_ndmi",
                value = sd_ndmi
            )
        
        # write the temp row: mean_monthly_mean
        mean_monthly_mean_temp_vals <- terra::values(temp[["mean_monthly_mean"]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "mean_monthly_mean_temp",
                value = mean(mean_monthly_mean_temp_vals)
            )
        # write the temp row: mean_monthly_max
        mean_monthly_max_temp_vals <- terra::values(temp[["mean_monthly_max"]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "mean_monthly_max_temp",
                value = mean(mean_monthly_max_temp_vals)
            )
        # write the temp row: mean_monthly_min
        mean_monthly_min_temp_vals <- terra::values(temp[["mean_monthly_min"]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "mean_monthly_min_temp",
                value = mean(mean_monthly_min_temp_vals)
            )
        # write temp row: max_monthly_max
        max_monthly_max_temp_vals <- terra::values(temp[["max_monthly_max"]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "max_monthly_max_temp",
                value = mean(max_monthly_max_temp_vals)
            )
        # write temp row: min_monthly_min
        min_monthly_min_temp_vals <- terra::values(temp[["min_monthly_min"]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "min_monthly_min_temp",
                value = mean(min_monthly_min_temp_vals)
            )
        # write the precip rows: mean over pixels = mean of the voronoi values weighted by how many park pixels each covers
        mean_monthly_daily_sum_precip_vals <- terra::values(precip[["mean_monthly_daily_sum"]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "precip",
                stats = "mean_monthly_daily_sum_precip",
                value = mean(mean_monthly_daily_sum_precip_vals)
            )
        cumulative_monthly_precip_vals <- terra::values(precip[["cumulative_monthly"]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        parks_all <- parks_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                month = yearmonth(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y,m)),
                variable = "precip",
                stats = "cumulative_monthly_precip",
                value = mean(cumulative_monthly_precip_vals)
            )
    }
}
```

let's quickly find the outliers of the parks NDMI and NDVI by making a boxplot

```{r}
parks_all |>
    filter(stats %in% c("mean_ndvi", "mean_ndmi"), is.finite(value)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(month), y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~ stats, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Month", y = "Difference from baseline")

ndvimi_outliers <- parks_all |>
    filter(stats %in% c("mean_ndvi", "mean_ndmi"), is.finite(value)) |>
    group_by(stats, month) |>
    mutate(
        q1 = quantile(value, 0.25),
        q3 = quantile(value, 0.75),
        iqr = q3 - q1,
        is_outlier = value < q1 - 1.5 * iqr | value > q3 + 1.5 * iqr
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(is_outlier) |>
    select(name, month, stats, value)


```

# Giant CSV with pixel for every park for every month of October 2022 to September 2026

NO MORE MEAN DIFFERENCE

Turn all the monthly rasters from October 2020 to September 2026 per pixel into csv per park

Column format:
park name | x_coord | y_coord | month | year | variable | stats | value
variable and stats will be: mean NDVI, mean NDMI, mean monthly mean temp, mean monthly max temp, mean monthly min temp, max monthly max temp, min monthly min temp, cumulative monthly precip, monthly mean daily precip

```{r}
csv_all <- tibble(
    name = character(),
    x = double(),
    y = double(),
    month = month(),
    year = year(),
    variable = character(),
    stats = character(),
    value = double()
)
```
